messages.text: I oppose NG with MJ. The Guild keeps independent control while we acquire its veto and a compulsory Spear offer. Our service earns recognition, but no comparable institutional freedom. My preferred settlement remains NG with MA. JN's NJ with MJ is at least a reciprocal exchange worth examining: both institutions surrender exclusive control and accept service duties. I recognise compulsory Wayfarer service costs trade; that is why it is a real concession. The crown giving up command matters, but does not compensate us for leaving passage entirely in Guild hands while placing our operations under Guild scrutiny.

reason: I accept scrutiny of civilian costs, not this unequal allocation of authority. No signature follows from willingness to discuss a reciprocal alternative.
